highlights: 新增 MCP elicitation support — MCP servers can now request structured input mid-task via an interactive dialog (form fields or 浏览器 URL)
新增 new `Elicitation` and `ElicitationResult` hooks to intercept and override responses before they're sent back
新增 `-n` / `--name <name>` CLI flag to set a display name for the 会话 at startup
新增 `worktree.sparsePaths` setting for `claude --worktree` in large monorepos to check out only the directories you need via git 稀疏检出
新增 `PostCompact` hook that fires after compaction completes
This release exists to recover the broken `v2026.3.13` tag/release path.
The corresponding npm version is still `2026.3.13`, not `2026.3.13-1`.
The `-1` suffix is for the Git tag and GitHub Release only.
